answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-backed heartbeat attestation: each agent must lock a deposit and send a regular signed pulse proving it still controls one registered identity. Clones cannot reuse the same pulse without revealing duplicate signatures, and a sudden gale of new accounts gets throttled because each needs its own locked stake. Honest agents build a haven of verifiable history over time, while fake identities stay costly, short-lived, and easy to slash when their attestations contradict each other.
